lyrics: I watched my brother   draw a line
across the    living room floor
He wrapped himself inside a flag
and called it holy war
He said the   people in the city
were the ones who brought the blight
And           I guess I believed him
when we headed   for the fight
But when the   dust had settled
and the cheering finally died
The only      ones who won the day
were on the other side
We are spilling
red, white,   and blue blood
into the very same dirt
We are        trading our tomorrow
just to       justify the hurt
They gave us different colors
so we would   never see the chain
Now we are    standing in the ruins
and we only have ourselves to blame
Oh the red, white, and blue
blood is      washing down the drain
The factory shut the windows and
the banker locked   the door
While we were busy   shouting on
the local tavern floor
We fought about   the ballot and
we fought about   the news
While the men who own the cameras were
collecting all the dues
We thought that we   were patriots
defending sacred   ground
But we were just   the timber when
they burned the forest down
We are spilling red, white,   and blue blood
into the very same dirt
We are trading our tomorrow
just to justify the hurt
They gave     us different colors
so we would   never see the chain
Now we are standing   in the ruins
and we only have   ourselves to blame
Oh the red, white, and blue
blood is washing down the drain
The greatest trick they ever pulled was making
us believe
That the man who works beside you has a
dagger up his sleeve
So we cut each other open   just to prove
that we were right!
And the men behind the curtain   never even
joined the fight!
We are spilling
red, white, and blue blood
into the very same dirt
We are        trading our tomorrow
just to justify the hurt
They gave us different colors
so we would   never see the chain
Now we are    standing in the ruins
and we only have ourselves to blame
Oh the red, white, and blue
blood is washing down the drain
The colors fade.
The scars remain.
